// Button — generated Web Component (custom element) for the design system.
// Thin shell: it composes the canonical CSS classes onto its host; the craft stays in
// the source stylesheet (code-as-source-of-truth). Requires the DS stylesheet at runtime.
// Bound source classes: hbtn, hbtn--acc, hbtn--sm, sq.

export class ButtonElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["size", "variant"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this._render();
  }

  _render() {
    const cls = [
      "hbtn",
      this.getAttribute("size") === "s" && "hbtn--sm",
      this.getAttribute("variant") === "acc" && "hbtn--acc",
    ].filter(Boolean);

    const host = this.querySelector("button") ?? this._mount();
    host.className = cls.join(" ");
  }

  _mount() {
    const host = document.createElement("button");
    const deco_sq = document.createElement("span");
    deco_sq.className = "sq";
    deco_sq.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    host.appendChild(deco_sq);
    host.appendChild(document.createElement("slot"));
    this.appendChild(host);
    return host;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("x-button")) {
  customElements.define("x-button", ButtonElement);
}
